key_insight: SwarmLink adds peer-to-peer coordination so multiple UAVs can redistribute sensing tasks at runtime, keeping photovoltaic inspections resilient to failures and poor-quality captures.
engineering_relevance: The approach improves mission robustness for large-scale solar farm inspections by removing dependence on a centralized ground station and enabling autonomous recovery without changing the host aerial stack.
method: Non-invasive inter-agent communication layer that plugs into existing UAV frameworks
Distributed auction for target allocation, platform-failure recovery, and data-quality-triggered reassignment
Integrated with Aerostack2 while requiring no core modifications
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a photovoltaic plant inspection case study showing that all disruption scenarios are handled by a single re-auction mechanism over remaining targets and active platforms.
watch_item: The main implementation concern is reliable inter-UAV communication, since the resilience gain depends on maintaining enough connectivity for auctions and reassignments to proceed.
paper_title: Distributed Coordination for Resilient Multi-UAV Remote Sensing: A Photovoltaic Inspection Case Study
